selection_rule.primary: dev mean reward, greedy (temperature 0, 1 sample), authoritative offline evaluator
selection_rule.tie_break_1: dev stress mean reward — temperature 1.0, 4 samples per task, fixed seed, same authoritative offline evaluator, dev only
selection_rule.tie_break_2: fewer GRPO steps (cheaper and less overfit)

holdout_policy: Holdout is not consulted for selection and will be run exactly once at the end with frozen split SHA256 a22a8e989ba9b081a73afae2c86e215b3bf56e4886676726e34d8693f5a62701.
warm_start_policy: SFT warm starts are rank-matched: a rank-16 state loads as a rank-16 client regardless of Config.lora_rank.
constraints: Dev is used for selection and stress evaluation only.
Malformed tool calls are rejected and counted, not silently repaired.
No authoritative USD billing figure is available; preserve raw 404 receipts and record tokens and wall clock.
